title: Early bird special.
subject: PNN: The benefits of dinner at four. A study, with statistics, and six porches.
preheader: Dinner at four, six homes by 7:30, in bed by eight. The science of the early seating.

featuredCase.teaser: **Dinner at four. Six homes by 7:30. Lights out before eight.** The Silver Bullets went out before the neighborhood finished its dishes and pranked six families. One household watched the whole thing and wrote a review. Clueso has the file. *One hotline is mentioned. Only one exists.*
featuredCase.hook: including a lineup where every suspect is already in pajamas

image.alt: PNN pencil-sketch suspect composite for case PNN-011: three cheerful suspects in homemade werewolf costumes walk down a garden path under a full moon, wearing wolf ears, faux-fur vests, and plaid flannel pajamas. One wears a striped nightcap and wolf-head slippers and holds yellow caution tape, one hugs a pillow, and one holds a pouch of silver spoons. Insets show a dinner plate beside a clock reading four and a bedroom clock a minute shy of eight. Margin notes read: Dinner: 4:00. Prank: 7:30. Bed: 7:59. Moon: full. Suspects: sleepy.

What an early seating costs, and what it gets you.
(Prices in minutes of daylight. Gratuity: a nap.)

runs.text: 4:00 p.m. Soup, bread, and a firm warning about the moon.
Six porches, plated by 7:30. Served with flannel, fake fur, and caution tape. Seconds are not available.
Lights out at 7:59, served with a pillow. Included in the early-bird price, the only time dessert has ever been cheaper than a prank.
Paid in full by the household, in the form of a review. Tip: one hotline, which does not exist.
Not on the menu. Rule 7. PNN checked.

sections.heading:
Are you an early bird?
(Probably. Possibly. Keep reading.)

runs.text: 02 / You carry a pillow in public.
The Silver Bullets did. A sketch is on file.
03 / You have described a full moon as 'a reason to be home.'
The Bullets did. In writing, with a warning label.
04 / You announced a hotline without installing the phone.
A department has a name. A hotline has a number. Clueso is waiting.
05 / You were asleep before the stars were.
The Bullets drew theirs on a chalkboard ahead of time. It saved a trip.
The Bureau suggests dessert before four.
